# Party at Red Rocks (Denver / Boulder / Colorado Springs)
Primary: Concert transportation + venue intel + scene hubs.

Key pages:
- /week (this week’s shows)
- /venues (venue directory)
- /venues/{slug} (venue intel + upcoming)
- /scene/jam (jam scene hub)
- /scene/edm (EDM/bass scene hub)
- /scene/hiphop (hip-hop scene hub)
- /shows/{id} (show intel + shuttle options)

Data sources (used for enrichment/caching):
- SeatGeek (events/venues)
- Ticketmaster (fallback/events)
- MusicBrainz (entity IDs + canonical metadata)
- Setlist.fm (setlists)
- Last.fm (tags + discovery)

Freshness:
- Scene + venue caches refresh via /api/cron/sync and are timestamped on-page.

Business:
- Service area: Denver, Boulder, Colorado Springs (Front Range).
- Booking: /book (shared + private options).
